title: Billing Desk Clause: Honored Quote and Quote Overrun Waiver — Marlowe & Finch Alterations
content:
**Clause.** Work the customer approves is added to the Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket's quoted total, so the overrun charges that run past the honored amount are unapproved work and are waived as a quote overrun.

1. **Quoted total.** The quoted total on the ticket, including work the customer has approved.
2. **Overrun charges.** The overrun charges compared with the quote are every operation charge and every lined surcharge charge booked on the ticket.
3. **Quote tolerance, assembled from its form.** Under the per-operation form the quote tolerance is a flat 5.00 USD for each operation booked after the drop-off date; under the excess form it is the quote tolerance percentage of the overrun charges above the quoted total; under the quote form it is the quote tolerance percentage of the quoted total.
4. **Honored amount.** The honored amount is the quoted total, plus the quote tolerance, plus the fitting allowance, less the purchase credit and the tenure credit — and never less than the quoted total, so the waiver never reaches approved work. On this clause the quote tolerance takes the quote form at the class's quote-overrun tolerance percentage — that percentage of the quoted total — there is no fitting allowance and there is no credit.
5. **Waiver.** The quote overrun waiver is the overrun charges less the honored amount, rounded half up to the cent once at the end, and nothing when that is not above zero. Half up means a figure at or above the half-cent mark, or within 0.0001 of a cent below it, goes up to the next cent.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures: tolerance percentage 12)

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Quoted total | 200.00 USD |
| Quote tolerance: 12 percent of 200.00 | 24.00 USD |
| Honored amount: 200.00 plus 24.00 | 224.00 USD |
| Overrun charges: operations 210.00 plus lined surcharges 26.40 | 236.40 USD |
| Quote overrun waiver: 236.40 less 224.00 | 12.40 USD |

## Both sides of zero (same quote)

- Overrun charges of 224.00 USD: 224.00 less 224.00 is not above zero, so nothing is waived.
- Overrun charges of 224.01 USD: 0.01 USD is waived.
